name: claude-skills
description: Project-agnostic Claude Code skills for shipping software, designing UI before you build it, and turning static diagrams into animated walkthroughs.

plugins.name: agents-engineering
plugins.description: Build the thing: backend and frontend architects, AI and data engineers, DevOps, mobile, rapid prototyping, security engineering, and the small single-purpose agents for architecture, codegen, CI, docs and repo scanning.

plugins.name: agents-design
plugins.description: Decide how it looks and holds together: brand guardianship, UI and UX design, UX research and architecture, visual storytelling, image prompting, inclusive visuals, and the whimsy injector.

plugins.name: agents-marketing
plugins.description: Take it to market: content creation, growth hacking, app store optimisation, and per-channel specialists for Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Zhihu.

plugins.name: agents-product
plugins.description: Decide what to build next: sprint prioritisation, feedback synthesis, trend research, and a behavioural nudge engine.

plugins.name: agents-project-management
plugins.description: Keep the work moving: experiment tracking, project shepherding, studio operations and production, shipping, senior project management, and an orchestrator that dispatches the other agents.

plugins.name: agents-testing
plugins.description: Prove it works: API testing, accessibility auditing, performance benchmarking, test writing and fixing, results analysis, evidence collection, tool evaluation, workflow optimisation, and a reality checker.

plugins.name: agents-support-ops
plugins.description: Run it once it is live: support response, analytics and executive reporting, finance tracking, infrastructure maintenance, legal and compliance checks, and data consolidation, extraction and distribution.

plugins.name: agents-xr-spatial
plugins.description: Build for headsets and spatial platforms: XR interface architecture, cockpit interaction, immersive development, visionOS, and macOS Metal.

plugins.name: agents-specialized
plugins.description: The ones that fit nowhere else: agentic identity and trust architecture, cultural intelligence, developer advocacy, and a joker.

plugins.name: skills-azure-m365
plugins.description: Microsoft cloud: the Azure SDK skills across .NET, Java, Python, TypeScript and Rust — AI services, storage, messaging, Key Vault, Cosmos, monitoring — plus the M365 agent SDKs.

plugins.name: skills-cloud-infra
plugins.description: Everything that runs the thing: AWS and GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Docker, service mesh, observability and Grafana, deployment pipelines, incident response and on-call, networking and server management.

plugins.name: skills-security
plugins.description: Offensive and defensive security: penetration testing and the tooling around it, web vulnerability classes, privilege escalation, threat modelling and STRIDE, SAST, secrets management, malware and memory forensics, GDPR handling.

plugins.name: skills-languages
plugins.description: Language and framework depth: the -pro skills for Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, C, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Julia and Elixir, plus Django, FastAPI, NestJS, Prisma, Bun, .NET, Unity, Avalonia and the mobile stacks.

plugins.name: skills-web-frontend
plugins.description: The browser half: React, Next.js and Angular patterns, state management and modernisation, design systems and theming, accessibility and WCAG, web performance, i18n, and conversion-rate work on pages and forms.

plugins.name: skills-data-ai
plugins.description: Data and models: data engineering and pipelines, dbt, Spark, Airflow, databases from Postgres to vector stores, RAG and embeddings, LLM application patterns and evaluation, prompt engineering, agent memory, and multi-agent orchestration.

plugins.name: skills-devex
plugins.description: How the work gets done: git and PR workflows, commits and changelogs, TDD and testing patterns, debugging strategies, refactoring and tech debt, code review, planning and plan execution, worktrees, and authoring skills themselves.

plugins.name: skills-integrations
plugins.description: Wiring to other people’s systems: the automation skills for Slack, Jira, Notion, Asana, HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Zapier and Make, the Google and Microsoft suites, the messaging platforms, and the CRM and helpdesk tools.

plugins.name: skills-business
plugins.description: The commercial side: SEO from keywords to content refresh, paid ads and marketing psychology, pricing and launch strategy, startup analysis and financial modelling, product management, HR and culture, customer support and sales.

plugins.name: skills-content-docs
plugins.description: Writing and publishing: documentation architecture and templates, wikis and VitePress, tutorials, Mermaid diagrams, Office documents, doc co-authoring, and the video and article publishing skills.

plugins.name: skills-misc
plugins.description: The skills that fit none of the other groups cleanly — kept together rather than filed somewhere misleading.
